usage.callShape: POST https://x402.slinkylayer.ai/api/v1/proxy/52cfaeea-3451-42f7-9f80-24911ae96430/entity-sentiment with JSON body {text, requested_service} (x402, ~$0.05 USDC on base)

inputExample.text: Apple makes great products but their customer service is terrible.

usage.outputShape: untested — POST 402 challenge advertises JSON output ('analyzes the sentiment expressed about entities within the provided text using Google as the provider'); expect entity-level sentiment scores in the JSON body. Exact dot-path unknown until a paid call succeeds.
quirks: Registry lists method=GET but the endpoint is actually POST: GET returns HTTP 405 {"error":"Method not allowed. Use POST for this resource."} — MUST use POST.
Required body fields per the x402 402 outputSchema: text (string) AND requested_service (string). Omitting requested_service will likely 4xx.
Optional fields: google.key (object {key}) and encoding (string). google.key is optional — the proxy supplies Google credentials, so NO own API key is required.
Price is 50000 base-units = $0.05 USDC on Base (network=base, asset 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913, payTo 0x4f4BEb658084D7Bd7EA0b6F74DbF6e99f93d422d).

COULD NOT PAY-TEST in this sandbox: Node getaddrinfo/system DNS returns ENOTFOUND for slinkylayer.ai so qa-pay fetch fails ('provider request failed: fetch failed'); public DNS (8.8.8.8/1.1.1.1) resolves x402.slinkylayer.ai -> 35.207.217.226 and the host is alive. The endpoint is NOT broken — this is an environment DNS limitation. requested_service value 'entity-sentiment' is a guess from the route slug and was not confirmed by a paid call.
usage.guide: Call it as POST (not GET, despite the registry) to the proxy URL with a JSON body containing text (the document to analyze) and requested_service (use "entity-sentiment"). Payment is x402, ~$0.05 USDC on Base; no API key needed (the optional google.key is supplied by the proxy). The response is JSON with entity-level (aspect) sentiment scored per named entity in the text — read the entity/sentiment fields from the JSON body. Note this endpoint could not be paid-verified here due to a sandbox DNS resolution failure for slinkylayer.ai, even though the host is live; a future run from an environment with working DNS should confirm the exact output shape and the requested_service value.
